<p align="center"><strong>Find the song that opens the garden exit.</strong></p>


<p align="center">The key fits. The attic smells of wet leaves and burnt sugar. A tea table is laid for two. The second cup has your initials on it.</p>

<p align="center">Three bells guard the garden exit: snowflake, sun and leaf. Elias stands beside the cups, repeating, &quot;A little warmth before you go.&quot; His lips keep moving after the words stop.</p>

<p align="center">Under the table, his hand points urgently toward the bells.</p>
